programs.title: Cub Camp
programs.desc: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yara’s kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

director: Merit Jensen Carr: Producer, Shereen Jerret: Producer

programs.title: Wild Philippines
programs.desc: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

director: JOHANNES BERGER and STEPHAN KRASSER: Writers/Directors; SIMON RIEDEL and JÖRN RÖVER: Executive Producers

programs.title: Chasing the Rains
programs.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programs.title: Chasing the Rains
programs.desc: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenya’s wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants’ radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programs.title: Undiscovered Vistas
programs.desc: Learn about the world’s largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programs.title: Wildlife Icons
programs.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.
